extracted.intended_audience: ERC staff, Scientific Council delegates, panel members, and prospective peer reviewers
extracted.subtask_description: Responsibilities and governance guidance for selecting, composing, monitoring, and governing ERC evaluation panels and reviewers, including maintenance of expert databases and development of norms for the ERC peer evaluation system.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formulation of policies and procedures for selection of evaluation panel members and reviewers
rubrics_metrics.description: The Standing Committee on Panels is responsible for 'formulation of policies and procedures concerning the selection of ERC evaluation panel members and reviewers.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop and maintain clear, consistent selection policies and processes governing who is appointed as panel members and remote reviewers (procedural/eligibility standards, selection workflows).

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting up and monitoring an expanded database of experts
rubrics_metrics.description: The Committee is responsible for 'steering the setting up of an expanded data base of experts and its continued monitoring.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create and continuously monitor an expert database to support panel composition and reviewer selection (coverage, currency, accuracy and ongoing oversight).

rubrics_metrics.name: Preparing and approving specific proposals for panel composition
rubrics_metrics.description: The Committee prepares and approves 'specific proposals for panel composition.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce and validate concrete panel membership proposals for each evaluation round, ensuring panels are composed per ERC policies and requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Development of norms and rules for proper functioning of panels and the peer evaluation system
rubrics_metrics.description: The Committee is charged with the 'continued development of norms and rules for the proper functioning of the panels and, more generally, of the ERC peer evaluation system' based on feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Iteratively develop norms/rules informed by feedback from Scientific Officers, Scientific Council delegates to panel meetings, and other sources to ensure effective, fair, and consistent panel operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operational support and liaison role with ERC Scientific Management Department
rubrics_metrics.description: The Committee 'is assisted in its work by an Operational Standing Committee representing the ERC Scientific Management Department.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Coordinate operational implementation and administrative support via the Operational Standing Committee to translate policies into practice and ensure alignment with ERC management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Committee composition and leadership delegation rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Composition: 'The Committee on Panels consists of the Scientific Council Chair, and six further members, representing equally the three scientific ERC domains. The committee is chaired by the Scientific Council Chairperson who may delegate this task to a Vice-Chair.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure balanced representation across the three ERC scientific domains; allow formal delegation of chairing duties to a Vice-Chair when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adherence to key ERC guidance documents for peer review and AI use
rubrics_metrics.description: Key documents listed include 'The use of AI in grant proposal evaluation - Guidelines for ERC panel members and remote reviewers' and ERC Guides for Peer Reviewers for Starting & Consolidator, Advanced, and Synergy Grants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Panel members and remote reviewers should follow the specific ERC guides for peer reviewers and the AI-in-evaluation guidelines for the relevant grant schemes to comply with procedural and substantive expectations.
